# Feature parity with lazygit

The goal is 100%, measured rather than claimed: `parity/run.sh all` drives laziergit through every
one of lazygit's integration tests, unchanged, with real keypresses and real git, and checks the
screen the way lazygit checks its own. A test only counts when everything matches, wording included.

<!-- parity:begin (generated by go run ./parity/tasks; do not edit) -->

**670 of 671** of lazygit's own integration tests pass against laziergit (100%), and 100% of all their steps
already behave exactly like lazygit. Every failing test is a bug; [parity/TASKS.md](TASKS.md) lists them as tasks, biggest first.

Regenerated by `parity/run.sh all`. Areas are lazygit's `pkg/integration/tests` folders; the "stop at" column names the
[tasks](TASKS.md) holding back most of an area's failing tests, with how many each holds back.

<!-- parity:end -->

Known divergence: `laziergit <dir>` opens the repository at `<dir>`; lazygit accepts only `status`, `branch`, `log` or `stash` there and rejects anything else.
